policy: Conservative mapping: full only when the current Playwright test covers the official Zephyr intent end-to-end; partial when only part of the official steps/expected result is proven.

SAM-24962.test: MX QST 15 - Login via Home Page
SAM-24962.notes: Registered user session is verified on the MX storefront via visible account control.

SAM-24971.test: MX QST 06 + QST 07 + QST 08 - Add product and validate Cart
SAM-24971.notes: Cart, SKU and order summary are validated; the official Cart UI case also calls out thumbnail, services, info icons and footer, which are not all asserted in this test.

SAM-24981.notes: Samsung Care+ is added and reflected in cart, but the official case is specifically BC/PDP-oriented and uses WMC/PreQA context.

SAM-24982.notes: Trade-in UI is opened and validated, but the current test does not complete and prove the full official cart result.

SAM-24988.notes: A controlled cart proceeds through the checkout button and proves navigation to checkout/guest entry.

SAM-24994.notes: A new address is accepted through payment navigation, but the official scenario covers new shipping and billing address behavior more broadly.

SAM-25002.notes: Registered Base Store user reaches payment, fills card data, submits exactly once and captures the created MX order code.

SAM-25011.test: MX QST 19 - See exact order status
SAM-25011.notes: The automation searches and opens an exact order in BackOffice. The official case also mentions order/product basic and advanced search, so full coverage is not claimed.

extraAutomation.scope: Order fulfillment / controlled S1 cron flow
extraAutomation.notes: Useful business-flow automation, but not mapped to SAM-25011 because the official MX Backoffice TC is a search-validation case.
